specs.anchorText: Adding two bright pixels yields a dark one; subtracting a larger value from a smaller one yields a bright one.

One clear visual metaphor: uint8 arithmetic wraps around at 256, so adding two bright values can silently produce a dark result and speckle an image with garbage.
specs.alt: Two bright cartoon pixels high-five to add their brightness but a rolling odometer counter flips past its maximum back to zero so the combined pixel turns startled and pitch black, while a sunny sky shows blotches of dark garbage pixels nearby, illustrating how modular uint8 arithmetic wraps around at 256 and silently turns bright sums into dark glitch pixels.
specs.caption: Let uint8 do its own math and 200 plus 100 quietly becomes 44: the wraparound that turns bright skies into blotches of dark garbage.
